invariant: No software rule can make PoW immune to an adversary that can sustainably acquire the greatest valid cumulative work.
green_requires: frozen subsidy schedule and final fee/security-budget policy
deterministic subsidy/fee budget envelope across material eras
representative general-purpose mining work/W and work/$ evidence admitted for the final DP6 path
specialized/rentable-hash assumptions bounded to the evidence ceiling rather than asserted away
adverse low-participation and concentration scenarios evaluated
confirmation/reorg operating policy explicitly tied to observed/economic work conditions
no known work-function shortcut or consensus accounting defect makes valid work materially cheaper than the model assumes
machine_can_close_now: binding to existing DP6 and RDE evidence
correct_terminal_semantics: GREEN means the security assumption is explicitly bounded and evidence-backed; it never means 51%-proof.
